mechanism.name: local curvature profiles as a TRAIN-only structural teacher
mechanism.question: Does a commodity's local AF3 distribution -- the spread of its incident edge curvatures, its degree and its local closure -- reach the quantizer, and does the quantized geometry then carry it?
mechanism.one_sentence: A seven-dimensional structural profile computed only from the TRAIN behaviour graph supervises a head on the quantized readout, and a support-limited relational term asks similar profiles to stay close in the quantized geometry.
mechanism.distinct_from: A single AF3 scalar per edge is what the existing auxiliary term uses; M4 optimises the post-quantization AF3 expectation; M1/M2 move the geometry. Here the teacher is a distribution per node, not an edge value.
mechanism.export_independence: The head and the profile never appear on the export path: the exported identifier is the three tokens, and inference needs no behaviour graph.

computations.statement: p_i = [mean, std, q0.1, q0.5, q0.9, log(1 + d_i), t_i] over the incident AF3 values of node i, with t_i the local closure ratio and a mask for nodes with fewer than two incident edges; standardised with the location and scale of the valid TRAIN nodes.
p_hat_i = h_theta(phi(q_i)), a two-layer map from the quantized readout to the seven profile coordinates.
Huber(p_hat_i - p_i) averaged over the valid nodes and the seven coordinates.
eta * Huber((d_mix(phi_i, phi_j) - (a + b ||p_i - p_j||)) / rmse) on the fixed TRAIN support's real edges, where (a, b) is a least-squares fit on that support and rmse its residual scale.
computations.retention: The term is kept only if the frozen diagnostic finds the fitted line's sign agrees with the support edges' ordering (corr(||p_i - p_j||, distance) >= 0). Otherwise it is removed before the run and the mechanism is declared profile-to-quantizer only.

computations.statement: L = L_RQ + s [w_profile * Huber(p_hat - p) + w_geometry * eta * Huber((d_mix - (a + b||dp||))/rmse)]

inputs.graph: the canonical TRAIN behaviour graph with F_ij = 4 - d_i - d_j + 3 T_ij

outputs.sid: three tokens per item plus the deterministic disambiguation token, exported as results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_M3_role_profiles/item_sids.json
outputs.geometry: unchanged: E16 x H16 joint codewords, curvature 1, native residual, the baseline assignment rule

parameters.derivation: The scale is the repository's frozen gradient-share bound; the internal weights are declared unit weights. Neither is chosen by looking at a result.

gradient_rules.encoder: through the soft readout and the head
gradient_rules.codebooks: through the soft readout, both halves
gradient_rules.head: its own parameters, never exported
gradient_rules.scale: GradientBudget caps the new terms' combined encoder and codebook gradient at 0.10 of L_RQ's, reduced with MIN across ranks

training_integration.records: logs/training_metrics.jsonl carries a role event per epoch with the two terms, the scale and the fit

conventions.distance: d_0(x,y) = 2||x - y||; the mixed cost at alpha = 1/2 is the plain 32-dimensional squared distance
conventions.profile: computed from TRAIN edges only; a node with fewer than two incident edges is masked, never given a default profile
conventions.export: no profile, no head, no graph at inference

switches.BEHAVIOUR_ON: the profile and relational terms; off => L = L_RQ with the same geometry
switches.GEOMETRY_ON: the curvature of the mixed space; off => both halves Euclidean
switches.policy: the switches exist and are wired; no arm with a switch off is trained

excluded.reason: discrete; the rule is the baseline's
a frozen measurement of the TRAIN graph, not a differentiable quantity
computed once on the frozen support and then constant

continuous_surface.note: One coordinate of the profile term. The head, the mean over the seven coordinates and the relational term are additional differentiable parts of the same objective; they need a model and a support, so they are exercised by tests/test_gradient.py.
